APP DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT

This App Development Agreement (the "Agreement") is made on August 17, 2026 between Lantern Fitness Inc. ("Client") and the developer named on the signature page ("Developer").

Section 1 - The Project

1.1 Developer will build an iOS app that lets Client's members book classes, see their class history and get class reminders (the "App").
1.2 Developer will deliver a test build of the App by October 5, 2026 and the final build and source code by November 2, 2026.
1.3 Client will give Developer access to its booking system's API, its brand assets and a test account within five business days of signing.
1.4 The fee includes fixing any bug Client reports before it accepts the final build.
1.5 Developer decides how, when and where to do the work, and is an independent contractor, not an employee of Client.

Section 2 - Fees and Payment

2.1 Client will pay Developer a fixed fee of $18,000 for the App.
2.2 Client will pay one third of the fee on signing, one third on delivery of the test build and one third on acceptance of the final build.
2.3 Developer will invoice by email, and Client will pay each invoice within 15 days of receiving it.
2.4 Features beyond those in Section 1 are billed at $110 per hour, but only after Client approves an estimate in writing.

Section 3 - Acceptance

3.1 Client will test the final build within ten business days of delivery and either accept it or send a written list of bugs that stop it working as described in Section 1.
3.2 Developer will fix the listed bugs and redeliver within ten business days.

Section 4 - Ownership

4.1 Developer assigns to Client all rights in the App and in any other software, design, code or invention that Developer creates during the term of this Agreement and for two years after it ends, whether or not created for Client, including all code libraries, frameworks and tools Developer used to build the App, even those Developer owned before the start date.
4.2 Developer will not use any of the assigned code libraries, frameworks or tools for any other client without Client's written consent.
4.3 Client keeps all rights in its logos, brand assets, class data and member data.

Section 5 - Confidentiality

5.1 Each party will keep confidential any non-public information the other shares for this project and use it only for this project.
5.2 This obligation does not cover information that is public, already known to the receiving party, or lawfully received from someone else.

Section 6 - Term and Termination

6.1 This Agreement begins on signing and ends when Client has accepted and paid for the final build.
6.2 Either party may end this Agreement for any reason on 14 days' written notice by email.
6.3 If either party ends this Agreement early, Client will pay Developer for all work done up to the end date, prorated against the fixed fee.
6.4 This Agreement does not renew.

Section 7 - Other Work

7.1 Developer is free to build apps for other clients, including other gyms and fitness studios, during and after this Agreement.

Section 8 - Liability

8.1 Each party is responsible for claims caused by its own breach of this Agreement or its own negligence.
8.2 Each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fee paid or payable under it.

Section 9 - Disputes

9.1 Any dispute arising under this Agreement will be decided by the courts of the county where Developer lives.

Section 10 - General Terms

10.1 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties about the App.
10.2 Notices under this Agreement must be in writing and sent by email to the addresses on the signature page.
10.3 If any provision of this Agreement is found unenforceable, the remaining provisions stay in effect.
